_comment: Registration for `--verify-provenance` on the harness itself (issue #1732).
WHY IT NEEDS COMMITTED CASES (ADR 0008): every other control in this repository
rests on its anchor being the artifact its manifest says it is. The flag that
checks that crashed on the real tree until #1719 and was passed by nothing
until #1732, so its green had never been produced by the tree it verifies.
A historical anchor is a claim about a commit, and a case cannot carry a .git
directory, so run-case.sh builds a two-commit repository from each case.
TWO BAD CASES, the two ways the comparison can be owed: the anchor's bytes
differ from the commit it names, and the commit cannot be reached at all (a
depth-1 clone, which is what CI checks out). The second read `unverified`
before #1732 - the same word as an anchor with nothing to compare - and passed.
limits: Covers the HISTORICAL comparison under --strict --verify-provenance: bytes that differ from the named commit, and a commit absent from the clone. It does not cover an anchor whose bytes differ from its recorded digest (that is MISMATCH with or without the flag, pinned by tests/test_negative_controls.py), the non-strict run, the absence of git, or whether anything PASSES the flag - that last is pinned by tests/test_negative_controls_provenance_run.py, which reads the Makefile and the CI file. It says nothing about whether an anchor is BLIND; that is the verdict axis.

cases.name: bad-anchor-differs-from-its-commit
cases.why: The vendored anchor was edited after it was copied and its digest updated to match, so only the comparison with the commit can tell. If it scores GOOD an anchor can be swapped quietly.

cases.name: bad-commit-not-in-this-clone
cases.why: A correct anchor, run in a depth-1 clone where its commit does not exist. If it scores GOOD, 'could not look' is being read as 'nothing to compare' - the state of every historical anchor in CI's checkout.

cases.name: good-anchor-matches-its-commit
cases.why: The anchor is byte for byte the gate at the commit it names. Separates a working comparison from one wedged at MISMATCH.

cases.name: good-constructed-anchor-names-no-commit
cases.why: A constructed anchor with no sha key: nothing to compare, unverified, and not a failure. Fourteen registered controls are in this shape.

anchors.why: CONSTRUCTED: the wiring before #1732, where nothing passed --verify-provenance. It is the live harness with the flag removed, because the blindness was never in the harness's code. It passes both bad cases.
